Name: Cozbi
Summary: Cozbi, daughter of Zur, a prince of Midian, was brought into the camp by Zimri at the height of Israel's idolatry at Peor.
KeyStory: Cozbi was slain with Zimri by Phinehas, and her death marked the end of the plague on Israel.
RelatedPeople: Zimri, Son of Salu; Zur; Phinehas
LifeLesson: The pleasures of idolatry end where God's holiness begins.
